assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(2, [5, 6], 0, [[0, 1]]) == [-1]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(3, [1, 1, 1], 0, [[0, 2]]) == [1]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(4, [0, 100000, 50000, 50001], 1, [[0, 1], [2, 3]]) == [
    -1,
    1,
]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(
    5, [0, 100000, 50000, 50001, 50002], 100000, [[0, 1], [2, 4]]
) == [1, 1]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(5, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, [[0, 4], [1, 3]]) == [4, 2]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(6, [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11], 2, [[0, 5], [1, 4]]) == [5, 3]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(10**5, [0] * 10**5, 0, [[0, 99999]]) == [1]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(
    10**5, list(range(10**5)), 1, [[0, 99999], [50000, 50001]]
) == [99999, 1]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(
    10**5, list(range(0, 2 * 10**5, 2)), 2, [[0, 99999], [1, 99998]]
) == [99999, 99997]
assert sol.pathExistenceQueries(3, [-1, 0, 1], 1, [[0, 2], [1, 2]]) == [2, 1]
